Main.dc.html.title: Proposal cover — StaffWare on the web

New_ES.dc.html.title: New — Bid and transfer to Plan management

n1.text:
What changes
• 18 module codes become a clear menu grouped by area (Operations, Finance, Supply chain, Pre-construction)
• One search box finds any account, job, lot, employee or item
• Live numbers on the home page: open lots, billing to post, payroll pending, low stock
• Each user only sees the modules they have access to
• Works in any browser — no Access install, no 1920×1080 requirement

n2.text:
What changes
• Letter codes (A…K) next to every button are replaced by filters that appear only for the report you pick
• 30+ grey buttons become a searchable report list with descriptions
• Open-lots-per-period table becomes a chart you can click into
• Results open on screen first — sort, search, export to Excel/CSV, then print

n3.text:
What changes
• Billing becomes a guided 3-step flow: Process → Review pre-bill → Post
• Risky actions (Post billing, Clear snapshot) need a confirmation that shows exactly what will change
• The 'customer snapshot in use' box becomes a visible lock banner, so two people can't bill the same customer
• Invoices are searchable and printable from one list

n4.text:
What changes
• Items, stock and counts on one screen with live search
• Low stock and negative on-hand are flagged automatically instead of needing a report
• Inventory count is a step-by-step process (Start → Enter → Review → Post)
• 40 report buttons grouped into Stock, Material posted, Counter material and Counts

n5.text:
What changes
• Purchase orders in one list with status chips: Open, Back-ordered, Received, Billed
• Receive and bill a PO from the PO itself — no separate forms to hunt for
• Vendor price comparison shown while you add items
• Post PO is one button with a summary of what posts to inventory

n6.text:
What changes
• Reports open in the browser instead of a fixed print preview
• Group headers collapse, columns sort, totals stay visible
• Click a lot to drill into its labor, material and billing detail
• Export to Excel/CSV or print to PDF with the same layout as today

n7.text:
What changes
• Payroll becomes 4 clear steps: Piece cards → Hourly cards → Review → Post
• One Post payroll button instead of "Post payroll" and "Post payroll (new)"
• Missing cards and problem lots are flagged before posting, not after
• About 28 reports move to a searchable Reports tab

n8.text:
What changes
• Customer → job → bid → plan shown as a breadcrumb, not 7 filter boxes
• Assemblies show their items and total cost in one card (no nested + datasheets)
• Transfer to Plan management is one panel: choose bid, plan or pack, and the app checks job, lock and duplicates first
• Price updates show a preview before they run
